title: Sehemu bora zaidi ya safari yangu Malaysia ilikuwa LaLaport
label: LaLaport

text.In Malaysia, I saw the twin towers and t: Nchini Malaysia niliona minara pacha na mtaa wa chakula.
text.But honestly, the best thing in Kuala Lu: Lakini kwa kweli, jambo bora zaidi Kuala Lumpur lilikuwa LaLaport.
text.LaLaport is a shopping mall made by Mits: LaLaport ni kituo cha ununuzi kilichotengenezwa na kampuni ya Japani ya Mitsui Fudosan, na kinakufahamika katika mji wangu wa nyumbani.
LaLaport ya Kuala Lumpur ilifunguliwa mwaka 2022.
text.When it opened, it was the biggest of al: Kilipofunguliwa, kilikuwa LaLaport kubwa kuliko zote, hata zile za Japani.
text.Surprisingly, it is bigger than the orig: Cha kushangaza, ni kikubwa kuliko kile cha awali.
text.Shopping malls abroad somehow feel like: Vituo vya ununuzi vya nchi za nje kwa namna fulani huhisi kama vya chuma, na majengo huonekana mazito.
text.The mall under the twin towers was like: Kituo cha ununuzi chini ya minara pacha pia kilikuwa hivyo.
Lakini LaLaport ni angavu na chepesi.
text.Even the toilets are shiny like in Japan: Hata vyoo vinang'aa kama vilivyo Japani.
text.The inside looks just like the LaLaport: Ndani panafanana kabisa na LaLaport ya mji wangu wa nyumbani.
text.My sister and I felt relieved the moment: Mimi na dada yangu tulihisi faraja mara tu tulipoingia.
text.Only inside LaLaport, it feels like I we: Ni ndani ya LaLaport tu ninapohisi kana kwamba nimepitia mlango wa kwenda popote.
text.I almost really thought, \"Huh, did I co: Karibu kabisa nilidhani, ‘Hee, je, nimerudi Japani?’
text.LaLaport is trying so hard abroad🥺: LaLaport inajitahidi sana hata nje ya nchi 🥺
text.As a Japanese person, I somehow felt pro: Kama Mjapani, kwa namna fulani nilijisikia fahari na furaha.
text.When you get tired in Southeast Asia, bo: Ukichoka Kusini-Mashariki mwa Asia, tumia hoteli kwa mapumziko ya mchana
text.At the Petronas Twin Towers, people do a: Biashara ndogo ya kupiga picha kwenye Petronas Towers
